scope: In-place Voicy setup and writing recovery demonstration. Original travel homepage retained. No real permissions, native shortcut, provider call, app insertion or deployment.
previousGoalTurn: Progress: Promptilo editorial/public consistency and canonical return were fixed, with two reproduced regressions and 140 passing workspace tests. This turn continues from 68/41/71.
changes: Text works immediately. Choosing a voice activation exposes proposed microphone rationale before simulated capture. Denial preserves the text route and is not repeatedly prompted; explicit simulated restoration never starts capture automatically.
A conflicting sample shortcut retains visible menu/text activation and a menu voice route. The page does not replace a shortcut or request keyboard access.

App-control rationale appears only after approving insertion into an available target. Denial retains approved text for selectable/copy fallback. A simulated grant returns to review for another explicit approval and target check.

Unsubmitted transcript edits survive activation/cancel. An unchanged source retains the edited proposal; a changed source requires an explicit keep/replace decision and each proposal shows its actual source.
Provider failure has an in-flow retry that retains text; unsupported actions preserve the original. Seeded wrappers are explicitly not transcription or translation.

Successful or uncertain insertion consumes the one-attempt record across review/edit/regeneration. A separate sample is explicit and retains earlier uncertainty context. UI and handler both reject repeated attempts.

Current study date, proposed design boundaries and Apple permission references are visible in the existing case/demo. Native build, device behavior, exact mechanisms and user outcomes remain unverified.
